info.name: RAGBook
info.description:
API collection for the RAGBook RAG application.

**Health**: server smoke test, run this first.
**E2E Flow**: sequential happy path, use with the Collection Runner.
**Collections / Documents / Ingest / Search**: individual APIs, with auto-save of variables.
**Cleanup**: deletions, at the end so a full run reaches it with everything still standing.

The folder order is designed to support a Run of the whole collection.

manual = every request runs normally (default, manual use). full = meant for the Runner on the WHOLE collection: skips standalone folders and redundant cleanups, leaving Health + E2E Flow + prefix wipe.
Test server port (run_test_server.sh). Change to 8000 only if you really want to hit the dev server and its real data.

item.name: Health
item.description: Server smoke test. Run before the E2E: if `embedding_status` is not `ready`, ingest and search fail or hang.

exec: pm.expect(embedding, 'warming = model still loading/downloading; error = load failed, check the server logs').to.eql('ready');

request.description:
Returns `{"status": "ok", "embedding_status": "warming|ready|error"}`.

`status` is `ok` as soon as the port is open; `embedding_status` reflects the loading of the embedding model, which starts in the background at startup (on first boot it downloads the model from Hugging Face, which can take a while).

The value is saved in the `embedding_status` variable.

item.name: Search
item.description:
Search endpoints. Uses the `collection_id` variable.

All three endpoints (`/api/search`, `/api/search/raw`, `/api/search/stream`) accept the same optional tuning parameters in addition to `query`, `collection_id`, `top_k`, and `strategy`:

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Effect |
|-----------|------|-------|---------|--------|
| `min_score` | float | 0.0–1.0 | reranker-aware | Score filter threshold |
| `fusion` | `weighted` \| `rrf` | — | from settings | Hybrid merge strategy |
| `hybrid_vector_weight` | float | 0.0–1.0 | 0.7 | Weight of vector branch in weighted fusion |
| `max_results_per_document` | int | 1–10 | 2 | Cap on chunks per source document |
| `reranker_enabled` | bool | — | from settings | Enable/disable cross-encoder reranker |
| `llm_temperature` | float | 0.0–2.0 | 0.3 | Sampling temperature for answer generation |
| `llm_think` | bool | — | false | Ollama reasoning mode (no-op with Gemini) |
| `llm_num_ctx` | int | 2048–32768 | 8192 | LLM context window size (no-op with Gemini) |

Omit any field to use the server default. `GET /api/config` returns all effective defaults and valid ranges.

request.description:
RAG search with LLM answer + source chunks.

`strategy`: `vector`, `tfidf`, `hybrid`

Accepts optional per-request tuning parameters — see the folder description. Use the "Search (tuned)" request to see all eight parameters with example values.

Retrieves the top-k chunks without passing them to the LLM. Returns only the chunks with their scores.

Accepts optional per-request tuning parameters — see the folder description. Use the "Search (tuned)" request to see all eight parameters with example values.

body.raw:
{
  "query": "What is the main topic?",
  "collection_id": "{{collection_id}}",
  "top_k": 5,
  "strategy": "hybrid",
  "min_score": 0.3,
  "fusion": "weighted",
  "hybrid_vector_weight": 0.7,
  "max_results_per_document": 2,
  "reranker_enabled": true,
  "llm_temperature": 0.3,
  "llm_think": false,
  "llm_num_ctx": 8192
}

request.description:
Search with all eight tuning parameters explicitly set. Use this as a reference when experimenting with every knob.

- `min_score` (0.0–1.0): score filter threshold — applied to cross-encoder sigmoid scores when the reranker is active, to raw retrieval scores otherwise.
- `fusion` (`weighted` | `rrf`): hybrid merge strategy for this query.
- `hybrid_vector_weight` (0.0–1.0): weight of the vector branch in weighted fusion.
- `max_results_per_document` (1–10): cap on chunks retained per source document after diversification.
- `reranker_enabled`: enable or disable the cross-encoder reranker for this query.
- `llm_temperature` (0.0–2.0): sampling temperature for answer generation.
- `llm_think`: enable the model's reasoning/thinking mode. **Ollama only — no-op with Gemini.**
- `llm_num_ctx` (2048–32768): context window size for the LLM call. **Ollama only — no-op with Gemini.** The loaded model may reject high values.

item.name: Config
item.description: Server configuration endpoint. Returns the effective defaults and valid ranges for all eight per-request tuning parameters. The UI uses this endpoint on startup to populate the Advanced search controls without duplicating configuration constants.

request.description:
Returns the server's effective defaults and valid ranges for all eight per-request tuning parameters.

Response shape:
```json
{
  "llm_provider": "ollama",
  "defaults": {
    "min_score": 0.3,
    "fusion": "weighted",
    "hybrid_vector_weight": 0.7,
    "max_results_per_document": 2,
    "reranker_enabled": true,
    "llm_temperature": 0.3,
    "llm_think": false,
    "llm_num_ctx": 8192
  },
  "ranges": {
    "min_score":                {"min": 0.0,  "max": 1.0,   "step": 0.05},
    "hybrid_vector_weight":     {"min": 0.0,  "max": 1.0,   "step": 0.05},
    "max_results_per_document": {"min": 1,    "max": 10,    "step": 1},
    "llm_temperature":          {"min": 0.0,  "max": 2.0,   "step": 0.1},
    "llm_num_ctx":              {"min": 2048, "max": 32768, "step": 2048}
  }
}
```

`defaults.min_score` is reranker-aware: equals `RERANK_MIN_SCORE` when `reranker_enabled` is `true`, otherwise `MIN_SCORE`. `llm_think` and `llm_num_ctx` are Ollama-only; the UI hides them when `llm_provider != "ollama"`.

request.description:
Deletes ONLY collections whose name starts with the `test_prefix` variable (default `[postman_test]`), along with their documents.
Collections without that prefix are preserved and counted in the log.
If `test_prefix` is empty the request deletes nothing.

Use it to clean up leftovers from a failed E2E run.
